name: PLAZA MARKET BUILDING
text: This blue corrugated structure houses the
Plaza Market. The orange neon sign hums above
a wide open doorway, inviting scavengers to
trade their finds.

name: REPAIR HUB BUILDING
text: An orange corrugated building marked as the
Repair Hub, its blue neon sign flickering
slightly. The roller door is partially open,
suggesting ongoing mechanical work inside.

name: GLOWING WATER CANAL
text: A narrow canal filled with vividly luminescent
cyan water flows steadily beneath the metal
grating. It casts a soft, synthetic glow
against the surrounding concrete walls.

name: THICK POWER CABLES
text: A bundle of heavy, dark cables snakes across
the floor grating, connecting the hydroponic
tanks to the central pylon. They look worn but
essential for distributing power.

name: HYDROPONIC PLANT TANK
text: A cylindrical glass tank containing tiered
levels of vibrant green, leafy plants. The
structure glows from within, sustaining the
flora with a steady supply of cyan liquid.

name: HYDROPONIC PLANT TANK
text: Another glowing tank preserving a vertical
garden of broad-leafed plants. It stands as a
small pocket of cultivated life against the
stark industrial background.

name: GLOWING CENTRAL PYLON
text: A robust mechanical pylon anchors the center
of the plaza, emitting a warm orange light
from its core. It serves as a vital energy
node, channeling power to the surrounding

name: STACKED CARDBOARD BOXES
text: A messy stack of battered cardboard boxes
rests near the edge of the walkway. Someone
has left a loose piece of paper sitting on top
of the pile.

name: SCRAP METAL DRUMS
text: Several rusted metal drums and scattered
mechanical parts sit forgotten on the concrete
platform. They look like leftover scrap
waiting to be repurposed.

name: GLOWING WATER CANAL
text: The cyan liquid flows out from a dark culvert,
continuing its bright path along the channel.
The glowing fluid seems to be the lifeblood of
this sector.

name: HYDROPONIC PLANT TANK
text: A smaller, single-tier hydroponic tank
sustains a solitary green plant near the edge
of the lower platform. It glows with the same
pervasive cyan light as the others.

name: TANGLED POWER CORDS
text: A messy jumble of dark cords spills out from a
grey utility box attached to the wall. They
snake haphazardly across the floor toward a
nearby machine.

name: WALL-MOUNTED GENERATOR UNIT
text: A boxy grey machine with a bright cyan display
panel is affixed to the wall near the repair
hub. It hums quietly, part of the station's
localized grid.

name: ROOF AC UNIT
text: A standard grey air conditioning unit with a
large circular fan sits on the roof of the
lower structure. It vents exhaust from the
rooms below.
